summary: Added load_decathlon_datalist(data_list_file_path, is_segmentation=True, data_list_key="training", base_dir=None) to monai/data/utils.py. It reads a Decathlon-style JSON datalist, resolves image/label paths against base_dir (defaulting to the JSON file's directory), and validates the key and item format. Added tests/test_load_decathlon_datalist.py with four unittest cases. Nothing was run, per instructions, so the tests are unverified. No commit was made. Docs were not updated.
